description: Managed metadata term sets. Values are structural examples for the pilot and require confirmation against the chosen pilot business function. PRD OQ-04, OQ-12.
status: Provisional - term values require stakeholder confirmation (OQ-04, OQ-12). Term set structure and governance model are not provisional.

governance.termStoreAdministrators: Nominated Document Control and Information Architecture roles only.
governance.deprecationRule: Terms are deprecated, never deleted, so historical items remain resolvable. PRD section 17.3.
governance.openTermSetsRationale: Closed term sets prevent uncontrolled vocabulary growth, which would break refiners, routing and reporting.

termSets.name: Business Function
termSets.description: Top-level organisational function that owns the document.

termSets.name: Business Process
termSets.description: The process the document supports. Hierarchy mirrors Business Function for filtered selection.

termSets.name: Applicability
termSets.description: The context within which exactly one revision may be effective. PRD F-013. Changing this term set changes the uniqueness boundary and requires an architecture decision.
termSets.criticalNote: The effective-revision uniqueness invariant is evaluated per Document ID AND applicability context.

termSets.name: Site and Region
termSets.description: Optional geographic scoping. Multi-region retention variation is out of MVP scope. PRD OQ-16.
